slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
quietly self assured

rock climbing

climb at an indoor wall once a week. every route is a small fear you face with your own body, and that courage quietly follows you out into everyday life.

choir singing

join a local choir, even if you think you can't sing. using your voice out loud among other people is a gentle way to stop being afraid of being heard.

a daily lesson

spend 5 minutes a day learning something new: a strange animal, a lost empire, a famous painting. knowing interesting things makes walking into any room easier.
slides.texte_sophia:
a daily lesson

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something new: a strange animal, a lost empire. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and walking into any room got easier.

slides.texte_overlay:
volunteering

help at a food bank or shelter once a month. being useful to people who need it gives you a steady kind of confidence that doesn't depend on anyone's approval.

long solo walks

walk alone for an hour every weekend, with no music. truly learning to enjoy your own company is the quiet base every other kind of confidence is built on.
